conventions.tensors: Column-major {shape,data}. Vocabulary ids, windows b and positions i are 1-based.
conventions.readers: reader index i+(b-1)T; window text includes all T input characters
conventions.attention_rows: [source, head], with zeros after reader i
conventions.pair_weights: [source in head 1, source in head 2], both sources in 1:i
conventions.p_by_pair: [vocab, source in head 1, source in head 2]
conventions.p_by_source: [vocab, source, head replaced], with the other head held at its usual output
conventions.p_single: [vocab, head sampled], the weighted arithmetic mean of p_by_source
conventions.diagnostics: [head]; entropy in nats, weighted_value_spread is an average squared Euclidean distance
conventions.distances: KL and cross-entropy use natural logarithms, TV is half the L1 distance
